tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background and the bottom navigation bar.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Inactive view tabs, the search button, the 'see all' button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline between concert rows and above the bottom navigation.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. Also text on accent (9.9:1) and the fill of dark pills: active tab, reason tags, the listen button on a must-see card.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Reason sentence under a concert (14.1:1 on ground).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: venue, line-up, inactive date filters, inactive navigation (7.3:1 on ground).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Apricot, the one dominant colour. FILLS ONLY: must-see cards, the 'Nouveau' badge on rows, the dot of the wordmark, the underline of the active date filter (always with bold text). Never text, never under white text (1.8:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: The accent when it must be text: weekday labels in rows, 'Écouter' text buttons (6.1:1 on ground).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink pills.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons (like, share) sitting on an accent card.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: App name, lower case, with an accent full stop.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Concert title on a must-see card.

styles.name: day-number
styles.usage: Day of the month in the date column of a row.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: View tabs and date filters (600 when active, 400 when not).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Garage et post-punk du label Born Bad.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Header date line, small secondary text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Weekday label, reason tags (IA, Tes goûts), uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its venue line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card, between a tag and its sentence.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between must-see cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between date column and content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Must-see card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above each home section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Reason tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: 'Nouveau' badges.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Must-see cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: 44px buttons and round icon buttons; 20px tabs use the same pill shape.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.
